budget: External additive corrections ledger, predictions cap3600s and latency cap900s; no reset or legacy controller
checkpoint_lineage: Recovered historical clean-reproduction checkpoints, not the serialized files in the original final_freeze. Historical producer receipts record equality to original model states and predictions; this run preserves their own checksums and does not replace the original freeze.

latency_policy.admission_gate: All 78 CPU diagnostic predictors complete with immutable source/state, finite predictions and published alerts; original GPU-parity gate is not asserted
latency_policy.backend_scope: The same eager CPU backend is fixed for every candidate/reference and seed.
latency_policy.estimand: equal-seed mean of (candidate mean forward latency minus GRU32 mean forward latency), in seconds
latency_policy.excluded_scope: loading, preprocessing, serialization, finite checks, compilation and warmup; no GPU or service latency claim
latency_policy.hardware_scope: new secondary CPU measurement, not a replacement for historical A100 costs
latency_policy.input_rule: floor(block_id*654/99), common raw development window for candidate/reference and all six seeds; frozen model-specific transforms remain legitimate
latency_policy.statistical_scope: Separate CPU conditional/descriptive analysis only; original accuracy-GPU/cost-CPU IUT is not executed
latency_policy.statistical_unit: whole global timing block containing all six seed pairs; preserve blocks for subsequent resampling
latency_policy.timed_scope: CPU model forward call on an already resident batch-one FP32 tensor only

old_statistical_plan_714f32: Preserved as history but not an eligible IUT/gate for this new supplement

outputs.calibration_agreement.csv: 78 comparisons; max difference and alert flag, never a filter
outputs.predictions_calibration.csv: 4134 rows, same schema and all projections
outputs.predictions_train.csv: 51090 rows, original units, model/seed/date/split/error and hashes
outputs.raw_cpu_latency.csv: 12000 individual operations in 100 global blocks with 6 seed pairs per each of 10 candidate/GRU comparisons
outputs.risks_by_predictor.csv: 78 rows; CPU train RMSE, calibration RMSE and their difference; seeds paired, train/cal dates not paired

prediction_policy.comparison_scope: New CPU eager frozen projection versus saved GPU calibration reference; difference is numerical framework/hardware compatibility, not statistical equivalence
prediction_policy.difference_threshold_role: Published diagnostic alert only; retain all finite predictors and all differences, without filtering or stopping on an alert
prediction_policy.risk: RMSE computed in float64 from batch-one original-unit predictions
prediction_policy.tolerance_reason: FP32 CPU versus recorded A100 arithmetic; absolute sigma7 tolerance fixed before inference, much smaller than delta; not a statistical equivalence margin

scope: New exploratory CPU diagnostic registered after two failed strict CPU-to-GPU parity attempts; no historical preregistration, original parity, equivalence or new test claimed
statistics_admission: Independent statistics plan will bind this inference-plan SHA; execution admission must bind both hashes before loading Torch or weights. No circular modification of either plan.

supersedes_preexecution_plan.reason: Add missing stdlib math import before any diagnostic forward; prediction, alert and timing policies unchanged
